**CLAIM** — session `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`, branch `claude/issue-4475-members-role-gating`.

**Ruling (delegated authority; open veto window)**: gate the affordances by the active member's org role, using **the same page's own Settings tab as the in-file precedent** — it already does owner-gating right (form replaced by explanatory copy, destructive action disabled, Leave still enabled). Members/invitations tabs get the same treatment: a `member` sees no Invite button and no Remove-member row actions; the role comes from the org context the page already consumes (measure which roles CAN invite/remove rather than hardcoding "owner" — the server's better-auth role model is the truth; mirror what the Settings tab keys on and what the server's own gates enforce, and say what you keyed on).

**Scope guards**: (1) UI half ONLY — the server-side "can org_member read the invitation ledger" question is escalated as objectstack#8095, do NOT couple to it. (2) The card's probe note: the `remove-member` server path's gating is unverified from the client (lookup runs before permission check) — MEASURE it read-only and report; if the server genuinely does not gate remove-member, that is a stop-and-report finding for the objectstack lane, not something to fix here. (3) New user-facing strings via the channel #4474 just established (PR #4496 landed — `useObjectTranslation` inline defaults + all-ten-packs parity; the role-label resolver `resolveOrgRoleLabel` and error mapper now exist, reuse them, don't fork).

**Red-first**: member viewer on the members page → pre-fix Invite button enabled + Remove on every row (capture the DOM); post-fix neither affordance present, with the Settings-tab-style explanation where the design calls for one. Must-not-change (green both sides): owner/admin still see and use both affordances; Leave organization unaffected; the invitations tab's copy-link affordances follow the same measured role rule.

**Grading**: patch `@object-ui/app-shell`. Never major.

**Surface (mutual exclusion)**: `packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/manage/**` (MembersPage, InvitationsPage if its affordances need the same gate, InviteMemberDialog) + tests + one changeset. Disjoint from in-flight #4434 (test-support), #4464 (plugin-grid), #4465 (plugin-dashboard filter bar), #4467 (shell chrome/impersonation — dispatching in parallel, does NOT enter organizations/manage).
